info.title: CoDi API
info.description:
The public API for pey. This API is used to create payment links, generate CoDi QR codes and push notifications, and retrieve the details of payment links and transactions.

### Base URL

| Environment | URL |
|-------------|-----|
| Production | `https://api.pey.mx` |

> **Tip:** We recommend testing your integration directly in production with small amounts such as $0.01 MXN, so you test with real banks and see the actual payment flow. A dedicated test environment is coming soon. See [Test in production](https://docs.pey.mx/docs/tutorials/getting-started/create-an-api-key#test-in-production).

post.description: Creates a new CoDi QR code via Banxico to receive CoDi payments.

amount.description: The amount for the QR code in MXN (Mexican Peso). Must be greater than or equal to 0. Use 0 to let the payer enter the amount when scanning the QR.

concept.description: The concept shown to the payer.

expiration.description: Expiration time in seconds. Use 0 for no expiration. Minimum value when set is 360 (6 minutes).

numRef.description: Numeric reference for the QR code. Must be up to 7 digits (digits only).

generateImage.description: When true, the response includes qrImage: the QR rendered as a base64-encoded PNG. Generating the image can make the endpoint respond more slowly; if your integration needs faster responses, we recommend building the QR client-side from qrString.

bankAccountId.description: Pey identifier (ULID) of the bank account that will receive the payment, registered through [Register Bank Account](/docs/api/register-bank-account). The account must have `codiStatus: ACTIVE`. When omitted, the payment goes to the CoDi payment account linked to your API key.

metadata.description: Optional set of key/value pairs to attach custom data to the QR. Up to 50 pairs; keys up to 40 characters; values up to 500 characters. Values must be scalar (string, number, boolean, or null) - nested objects and arrays are not allowed. All values are stored and returned as strings (e.g. "123", "false", "null").

id.description: Unique identifier (IDC) for the created CoDi QR, assigned by Banxico

qrString.description: The QR payload string to encode into a QR image

qrImage.description: The QR rendered as a base64-encoded PNG (image/png). Only present when generateImage is true; null if the image could not be generated (the QR is still created).

post.description: Sends a CoDi push notification to a phone number via Banxico to request a payment.

amount.description: The amount to charge in MXN (Mexican Peso). Must be greater than 0 and up to 1,000,000.

phoneNumber.description: The 10-digit phone number of the payer to send the push notification to.

concept.description: The concept shown to the payer.

expiration.description: Expiration time for the push notification in seconds. Defaults to 360 (6 minutes) if not provided. Must be greater than or equal to 360.

numRef.description: Numeric reference for the payment. Must be up to 7 digits (digits only).

bankAccountId.description: Pey identifier (ULID) of the bank account that will receive the payment, registered through [Register Bank Account](/docs/api/register-bank-account). The account must have `codiStatus: ACTIVE`. When omitted, the payment goes to the CoDi payment account linked to your API key.

metadata.description: Optional set of key/value pairs to attach custom data to the push notification. Up to 50 pairs; keys up to 40 characters; values up to 500 characters. Values must be scalar (string, number, boolean, or null) - nested objects and arrays are not allowed. All values are stored and returned as strings (e.g. "123", "false", "null").

codiId.description: CoDi folio assigned by Banxico (20-digit identifier)

post.description: Registers a bank account (CLABE) under your API key so it can receive CoDi payments. The account is created with `codiStatus: PENDING`; Pey registers it with Banxico and updates the status to `ACTIVE` once it can receive payments, which takes up to 5 business days. Use [Get Bank Account](/docs/api/get-bank-account) to check the status, or listen for the [Bank Account Updated](/docs/webhooks/bank-account/updated) webhook, which is sent when the account becomes `ACTIVE`. Once the account is `ACTIVE`, pass its `id` as `bankAccountId` when creating a CoDi QR or push notification.

alias.description: Friendly alias for the bank account.

name.description: Full legal name of the account holder (individual or legal entity).

clabe.description: 18-digit CLABE. The check digit must be valid and the bank must have CoDi enabled.

entity.description: Type of entity that owns the account.

id.description: Pey identifier (ULID) of the bank account

x-enumDescriptions.PENDING: Received, not yet sent to Banxico.
x-enumDescriptions.ACTIVE: Registered. The account can receive CoDi payments.

codiStatus.description: CoDi registration status. New accounts start as `PENDING`. See [Bank Account](/docs/types/bank-account).

get.description: Retrieves a bank account registered through [Register Bank Account](/docs/api/register-bank-account) and its CoDi registration status. Use it to check when a `PENDING` account becomes `ACTIVE` and can be used as `bankAccountId` in payment requests. You can only retrieve bank accounts registered with your API key; accounts that do not exist or belong to another API key return a 404.

post.description: Creates a new payment link for processing payments. The payment link allows customers to complete payments and redirects them to the specified URLs upon completion or cancellation.

amount.description: The amount for the payment link in MXN (Mexican Peso). Must be greater than 0.

successUrl.description: The URL to redirect the customer to after a successful payment. Must use HTTPS.

backUrl.description: The URL to redirect the customer to if they cancel or go back from the payment page. Must use HTTPS.

hasTip.description: Whether to enable tipping functionality on the payment page. Defaults to false.

clientReferenceId.description: A custom reference ID provided by the client for tracking purposes. Must be a string with a maximum of 255 characters.

metadata.description: Optional set of key/value pairs to attach custom data to the payment link. Up to 50 pairs; keys up to 40 characters; values up to 500 characters. Values must be scalar (string, number, boolean, or null) - nested objects and arrays are not allowed. All values are stored and returned as strings (e.g. "123", "false", "null").

id.description: Unique identifier (ULID) for the created payment link

url.description: The full URL where customers can complete the payment

post.description: Updates the amount of an existing payment link. Only the `amount` field can be changed; no other attributes of the payment link may be modified. You can only update payment links that were created with your API key, and only while the payment link's status is `pending`. Once a payment link has moved past `pending` (for example, once a payment has started processing or completed), the amount can no longer be changed.

paymentLinkId.description: The unique identifier (ULID) of the payment link to update.

amount.description: The new amount for the payment link in MXN (Mexican Peso). Must be greater than 0. This is the only field that can be updated. Values with more than 2 decimal places are rounded to 2 decimal places (round-half-up) before being stored.

id.description: Unique identifier (ULID) for the updated payment link

amount.description: The new amount for the payment link in MXN (Mexican Peso)

get.description: Retrieves the details of a transaction. You can only retrieve transactions received through your API key. Transactions that do not exist or that belong to another API key return a 404. A CoDi QR is not a transaction: to retrieve the transactions of a CoDi QR, use [Get CoDi QR Transactions](./get-co-di-qr-transactions).

get.description: Retrieves the paid transactions received by a bank account registered through [Register Bank Account](/docs/api/register-bank-account), 80 per page and newest first. This includes the CoDi QR and CoDi push notification transactions that were created with that `bankAccountId`. If there are more transactions, use the `nextToken` from the response to retrieve the next page. You can only retrieve transactions of bank accounts registered with your API key; accounts that do not exist or belong to another API key return a 404.
